text:
Maria P: Morning — I'm covering sunrise (05:30-13:30 UTC). Quick handoff notes below, pls skim and ping if questions.

Maria P: What changed overnight:
- Small spike in token latency around 03:10 UTC in eu-west-1 (seen on dashboards). It correlated with a background batch job that retried too aggressively. I lowered the retry window; metrics now back to baseline. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
- No error budget burn for any customer-facing routes.

Maria P: What to watch:
- KV cache warmups: new model variant rollout still causes ~200ms cold-starts for first 2-3 requests to /v1/generate when cache misses. If you see repeated cold starts, try `curl -X POST https://internal-runner/prefill -d '{"model":"redwood-v3"}'` to warm.
- Watch eu-west-1 tail latency between 06:00-09:00 UTC (expected higher traffic from APAC gateway).

Samir: noted on the prefill command. I pushed a small script that runs every 5m for the rollout canary — will keep an eye and stop if it adds noise.

Alex: FYI I left an open review on the autoscaler change that reduces max-batch delay. Low risk but could increase CPU spikes during sudden load. If it looks like noisy CPU, revert or patch throttle settings.

Maria P: Action items for this shift:
- Jamie: hold for deploy rollback watch at 08:40 UTC (see deploy-bot). Please confirm healthcheck results at +5m and +15m.
- Samir: monitor prefix-cache hit rate, and log any >5% drop for more than 2 windows.
- Alex: standby for throttle tuning if CPU spikes >85% on any host.

Jamie: got it. I'll also run a quick canary curl test once deploy finishes: `for i in {1..5}; do curl -sS https://api.redwood.company/v1/health | jq .status; done`

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: inference-runtime v3.2.1 -> prod at 08:40 UTC. Rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m. Automatic rollback on 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 10m.

oncall-bot: No active incidents. Recent alerts: 1 info alert (high batch latency) resolved at 04:02 UTC.

Samir: linking the logs for the earlier 03:10 spike: https://logs.redwood.company/g/abc123 (search for `batch-retry` and `failed-attempts`)

Maria P: I pinned the runbook section "sunrise-shift-checklist" in the channel. Also uploaded a tiny diagnostics script to the infra repo: `scripts/sunrise-diagnostics.sh` — use when testing cache/latency.

Alex: small reminder — if you need to drain a node for debug, use `infra drain-node <id> --grace 120` and then watch `kubectl get pods -w`. Avoid draining more than one node in the same AZ.

Jamie: quick Q — any expected customer traffic spikes today?

Maria P: Not that I know of; marketing flagged a minor blog post but no large campaign. If we see a surge, it'll likely be organic.

Jamie: cool, thanks.

Samir: I'll post an update at +30m after the deploy starts with cache hitrate and latencies.

Maria P: Thanks all — leaving my pager number in DM if needed. :phone:

Alex: :thumbsup: Good handoff.

deploy-bot: Deploy started at 08:40:12 UTC (canary 10%).

Samir: updating — canary healthy at +5m, 0 errors, cache hitrate stable. Posting again at +15m.

oncall-bot: Reminder: check oncall rotation schedule at https://console.redwood.company/oncall (next change in 6 days).
